description: This file defines the CreateGestureActivity class, an Android activity allowing users to create and save custom gestures. It handles gesture drawing, validation, saving gestures to a library, and user interactions like canceling or confirming gesture creation.

classes.name: CreateGestureActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for creating and saving user gestures.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads the layout, and sets up gesture listening.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current gesture state when activity is paused or stopped.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores the gesture state when activity is recreated.

methods.name: addGesture
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new gesture, saves it with a name, and provides user feedback.

methods.name: cancelGesture
methods.description: Cancels gesture creation and finishes the activity.
